title: Data Leakage through External Entity
description: The student may inadvertently share sensitive information (e.g., student ID, assignment content) when logging in and submitting assignments, leading to potential data leakage.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store sensitive data (e.g., student IDs, assignment files) insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Misuse by Process
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the data submitted by students (e.g., using it for purposes other than grading), leading to privacy violations.

title: Identifier Exposure
description: The grades portal shares data that includes unique identifiers such as student ID, which can be used to identify the data subject.

title: Processing of Identified Data
description: The assignment and grading service processes identified data, which may lead to unauthorized access or misuse of personal information.

title: Non-repudiation Threat
description: The data flow may create a situation where students cannot deny their submissions or grades due to the identifiable nature of the data being processed.

title: Data Disclosure of Personal Information
description: The grading service stores personal data (student id, course, submission time) which could be disclosed to unauthorized parties if proper access controls are not in place.

title: Data Disclosure of Stored Information
description: The stored assignment files in the Assignment Store may be accessed by unauthorized users, leading to potential data disclosure of personal information.

title: Processing of Identified Data
description: The teacher logs in and requests the queue of submissions, which may involve processing identified data of students, potentially leading to privacy concerns if the data is not handled properly.

title: Processing of Identified Data
description: The Grades Portal Web App processes the identified data of students when the teacher requests the queue of submissions, which could lead to unauthorized access or misuse of this data if proper security measures are not in place.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The portal may not have sufficient access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to view student submissions.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The teacher may mishandle or improperly store the sensitive data (student names and submissions), leading to potential data leaks or unauthorized access.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The teacher may retain student data longer than necessary, violating data minimization principles and increasing the risk of exposure.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The teacher may not have obtained explicit consent from the student to record and share their grades and feedback, leading to a lack of legal basis for processing personal data.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store grades and feedback insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Misuse
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the recorded grades and feedback, such as using them for purposes other than intended (e.g., marketing or profiling).

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The grading service may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to write grade records.

title: Data Breach Risk
description: The grade records database may be vulnerable to data breaches, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive student information.

title: Unintended Data Disclosure
description: The database may inadvertently disclose sensitive information through misconfigured access settings or inadequate data handling practices.

title: Identifying Data Processing
description: The system processes identified data when the student requests their own grades and feedback, which could lead to the exposure of personal information if not handled properly.

title: Data Misuse by Grades Portal
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the data received from the student, such as sharing it with unauthorized parties or using it for purposes other than intended.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grades
description: The process may inadvertently expose student grades to unauthorized users if proper access controls are not implemented.

title: Data Retention and Disposal Issues
description: The student may retain grades and feedback in their local device or account, leading to potential unauthorized access if the device is lost or compromised.

title: Legitimate Access to Data
description: The parent has legitimate access to their child's grades, but this access could be exploited if the parent's account is compromised.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The Grades Portal Web App may not adequately protect the data once received, leading to potential unauthorized access or data leaks.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The Grades Portal Web App may retain data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Unintended Data Disclosure
description: There is a risk that the Grades Portal Web App could unintentionally disclose sensitive information about the child or parent to unauthorized parties.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grades
description: The portal may inadvertently allow unauthorized access to a parent's child's grades if proper authentication and authorization mechanisms are not in place.

title: Data Misuse by Parent
description: The parent may misuse the accessed grades and feedback, leading to potential emotional distress for the child or inappropriate actions based on the information.

title: Legitimate Access by Administrator
description: The school administrator has legitimate access to create, modify, and disable accounts, which could lead to unauthorized changes if the administrator's account is compromised or misused.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The Grades Portal Web App may not adequately protect the data being processed, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information such as names and emails.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Grades Portal Web App may retain personal data longer than necessary, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Unintended Data Disclosure
description: The Grades Portal Web App may unintentionally disclose personal information to unauthorized users due to misconfigurations or bugs.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The grading service may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to write account records and parent-child relationship links to the account directory.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The account directory may store sensitive account records and parent-child relationship links insecurely, making them vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Leakage
description: The account directory may inadvertently expose account records and parent-child relationship links to unauthorized parties due to misconfigurations or lack of proper data handling procedures.

title: Data Disclosure during Transfer
description: The assignment and grading service transfers full grade records, assignments, and account directory to the cloud hosting provider, which may lead to unintended data disclosure if the data is intercepted during transmission or if the cloud provider mishandles the data.

title: Data Disclosure at Destination
description: The cloud hosting provider may store or process the received data in a way that could lead to unauthorized access or data breaches, resulting in the disclosure of sensitive information.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The Grade Records Database may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to access sensitive grade records.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The Assignment & Grading Service may mishandle sensitive data retrieved from the Grade Records Database, leading to potential data leaks or exposure.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Assignment & Grading Service may retain grade records longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.
